C0274.title: Beijing Chaoyang Police Bust Internet Company Using Crawlers to Steal Livestream Data, 23 Detained
C0274.summary: On October 15, 2021, Chaoyang police in Beijing disclosed a case of illegally obtaining computer information system data. A sudden surge in traffic was detected in a shopping website livestream room. Investigation found that a criminal gang led by Wang Yiyi, Yang Yuning, and Yang used crawler software to illegally steal livestream data and sold it online for profit. The gang registered a company as cover, built websites to trade data, earned over 400,000 yuan, and 23 suspects were arrested and subjected to criminal coercive measures.
